description: This file defines the Mongolian (Cyrillic, Mongolia) culture info for the DateJS library, including localized date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns, and date manipulation functions specific to this culture.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns the current date with time cleared.
